name: M. Emre Gündüz
intro: I'm a software engineer in Bonn, studying for an M.Sc. in Computer Science at the University of Bonn. I build software end to end, from EksperOne, the appraisal software I founded, to the back-end behind Türkiye's highway toll collection at ASELSAN. Away from the keyboard I take photos, and the photo books on this site are where they end up.

items.title: EksperOne
items.subtitle: Founder & Sole Engineer
items.text: SaaS + desktop software for vehicle damage appraisal offices · [eksperone.com](https://eksperone.com)
bullets: Shipped an **offline plate-recognition desktop app** (C#, YOLOv9 + OCR) that cut photo-sorting time from **40 min to 5 min**. Currently deployed at **2 offices**.
Built a **multi-tenant case-management platform** (.NET 10, PostgreSQL, React/TypeScript) with role-based access and audit logging.
Added mobile photo capture and customer upload links, removing manual photo transfers.
Owned **end-to-end delivery**: CI/CD, Docker, VPS deployment and Windows packaging.

items.title: TWINSOFT GmbH & Co. KG
items.subtitle: Software Engineer Working Student
bullets: Developed new features for a **biometric authentication mobile application**, improving usability, reliability, and security across core user flows
Designed and implemented a **health-check and diagnostics feature** that accelerated troubleshooting and helped pinpoint failure points across services and application components

items.title: Rheinmetall
items.subtitle: Software Engineer Working Student
bullets: Contributed as a core team member to the development of an internal logistics part management system using **.NET Framework**
**Resolved 60% of previously known issues**, significantly improving system stability and functionality
**Boosted application performance by 20%** through strategic code restructuring and rigorous optimization of key system functionalities, leading to faster loading times and reduced memory usage
Refactored legacy components to improve maintainability, reduce technical debt, and support faster feature delivery

items.title: ASELSAN
items.subtitle: Software Engineer
bullets: Led development of a **Flutter-based smart city application** designed to serve approximately **2,000,000 users**

**Engineered back-end services capable of handling 1,000,000 data entries daily** for Türkiye’s nationwide highway toll collection and traffic monitoring systems, optimizing data flow and storage using **.NET Framework**
Designed and built 2 predictive models for climate and air quality forecasting using Python, time-series analysis, and machine learning techniques
Collaborated with municipal governments and cross-functional teams to support seamless integration of the smart city platform and advance city-wide digital transformation efforts

bullets: **Graduated 3rd in the department** with a **3.73 GPA**, earning **high honors** for academic excellence. Completed a thesis project focused on **image recognition** techniques to detect **sea mucilage** (marine mucilage)
